description: Places travel.art maps around a museum, art fair or city guide: where to eat, where to stay, galleries, nearby museums, stations and entrances — with address, coordinates, a one-line editor's note, the official website and a Google Maps directions URL. Example questions: 'where to eat near the British Museum', 'hotels for Art Basel Miami'.

category.description: Filter by category (eat, hotel, gallery, museum…). Optional.

city.description: City — all mapped places in the city. Optional.

near.description: Museum, event or city guide name or id (e.g. 'British Museum', 'art-basel-miami-2026', 'Paris'). Optional if city is given.

name: find_places
title: Find places near a museum or event
